reason: Asserts frames' names (the `name` attribute, as `frame.name()` reports it, with the tree's nesting). Strider's frame tree has a `name` field, but no backend reports a frame's name, so it is always `None`. The matrix row says `has`, which holds only for the tree, not for names
`frame.page()` returns the page a frame belongs to. Strider's frame locators are entered from a page but carry no reference back to it, so there's no read that returns the page
